source.title: Options for Reducing the Deficit: 2025 to 2034

conventions.sign: deficitTenYearTotal and deficitByYear are normalised so negative always means the deficit falls. CBO reports revenues the other way round — positive revenue reduces the deficit — so those lines carry deficitSign -1 against their published figures.
conventions.excludes: Debt-service effects are not included in these tables, so combining options understates the interest saved.
